records.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6:38 — Changing the enabled category chooser while a save is pending makes the success callback display the new selection although the server saved the earlier category.
records.rationale: In save(), the success callback reads this.get('categoryId') at response time (host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))) rather than the saved props.category_id. The template only disables the save/cancel buttons (disabled=host.isSaving / cantSave); the category-chooser input is not disabled, so changing it while a save is pending would display the newer selection even though the server persisted the earlier one. The described mechanism matches the diff's code.

records.issue_text: db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:11 — Indexing the category query before checking for no match makes the migration crash on the default blank embed_category, blocking upgrades.
records.rationale: In the migration, `execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i` indexes element 0 before any nil check. On a default install, embed_category's setting value is '' (removed default in site_settings.yml shows `embed_category: ''`), so the INNER JOIN on `c.name = s.value` yields zero rows and `[0]` is nil, causing NoMethodError and aborting the migration for anyone upgrading.

records.issue_text: db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:11 — The migration dereferences an absent embed_category row, so sites that never persisted this optional setting abort the deployment.
records.rationale: The migration does `execute("... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i` with no nil guard. Sites where the embed_category setting row is absent (or its value matches no category, e.g. the default empty string '') return no rows, so [0] is nil and `nil['id']` raises NoMethodError, aborting the migration. By contrast, the very next query for 'embeddable_hosts' is explicitly guarded with `if embeddable_hosts && embeddable_hosts.cmd_tuples > 0`, showing the author knew absent rows were possible but only guarded one of the two queries. Confidence below 0.7 only because Discourse may seed

records.issue_text: db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:25 — Copying legacy host values without stripping schemes and paths causes previously accepted URL-form hosts to stop authorizing embeds after migration.
records.rationale: The migration inserts legacy host values raw via SQL ('INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)'), bypassing EmbeddableHost's before_validation scheme/path stripping. The model's lookup does where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host), and the removed SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host? explicitly handled URL-form entries (old spec: SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts = 'http://eviltrout.com' worked). So legacy values like 'http://discourse.org' stored verbatim will fail exact host comparison after migration, silently breaking embeds until manually edited.

records.issue_text: db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:25 — Interpolating legacy host URLs directly into SQL allows apostrophes in stored URL paths to abort the migration and crafted values to alter the statement.
records.rationale: The migration line `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, category_id, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"` interpolates legacy site_setting values directly into SQL. Values from the removed `embeddable_hosts` setting (free-form host list) are not quoted/escaped, so a value containing an apostrophe breaks the INSERT and could inject SQL. Verifiable in the diff.

records.issue_text: db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:25 — Migrated hosts retain previously supported URL schemes and paths because raw INSERT bypasses normalization, so existing embeds fail the new hostname lookup.
records.rationale: The migration inserts old embeddable_hosts values verbatim via raw SQL INSERT, bypassing the model's before_validation normalization (which strips scheme/path). Since EmbeddableHost.record_for_host does an exact lowercased hostname comparison against URI host, a migrated value like 'http://discourse.org' or 'https://example.com/1234' (formats explicitly supported by the old site setting and even used in the updated spec tests' Fabricate calls, which do get normalized) would fail host_allowed?, breaking existing embeds after upgrade.

records.issue_text: db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:31 — Deleting both legacy settings inside an irreversible change migration leaves rollback unable to restore embedding configuration and can disable all existing embeds.
records.rationale: The migration uses `def change` but performs irreversible data operations: `execute "DELETE FROM site_settings WHERE name IN ('embeddable_hosts', 'embed_category')"` plus SELECT/INSERT data migrations. Rolling back would either fail (data SQL cannot be auto-reversed under `change`) or at minimum permanently lose the legacy settings, with no down-path restoring them — a concrete, verifiable migration defect/data-loss risk grounded in the diff.
